title: Toys are ok, treats are not loved
text: We decided to give kitnipbox a try after having meowbox for a few mos.  Kit nip is ok, my cats have liked a couple of their toys, but I don't like the toys as much as meowbox and my cats didn't love the treats and hated the kitty wine.  Not a fan, going to try meowbox again.
label: neutral
